theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.32%) and Real Estate (+0.95%) led the market today, while Consumer Discretionary (-1.31%) and Materials (-1.24%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.32%, defensives +0.39%, and value/cyclicals -0.00% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.26%, Dow -0.04%, Nasdaq +0.54% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.61%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 4.78% to 14.55, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.16% to $4,469.00, crude oil was little changed at $82.58, and bitcoin slipped 0.17% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
